description:
Whether you’re trying to get the most out of your commute or just looking for a clean and convenient way to get across town, the S10X is your new go-to electric scooter. The GlareWheel S10X features a sleek LCD Display, a powerful motor that reaches up to 18 mph, and an easy folding system for portability. Easy and breezy, just the way we like it.

Wheels : Versatile and comfort by featuring 8.5 inch solid tires that easily ride over bumps and cracks in your city streets and sidewalks. Hight-powered 350W BLDC Hub motor offers hill climbing torque and improves performance in all demanding driving conditions.

APP Control

Ambiance LED light and LED headlight and tail light: Ride at night! The S10X is equipped with an ultra bright LED headlight and tail light, drive safe any time.

Foldable: Unique patented folding system makes it easy to go with you where ever you go.

Front and rear independent suspension system offers riding comfort

Max speed: 15 MPH Range: 12-18 Miles Motor：350W Battery：36V 8Ah Max Load: 220lb Charging Time: 4H

components.description: Build-in 120mm wider rear mechanical disc-brake. and rear fender foot brake
